{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Voxx}} {{CelestialBody |image=[[File:VoxxCluster-TheVoxxVortex5000.png]] |name=Voxx Cluster |region=*[[Outer Rim Territories]][[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] *[[The Slice]]The [[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] places the Voxx Cluster in the area of [[Realspace|space]] ''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' identifies as [[the Slice]]. |sector=[[Ash Worlds]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |system=[[Voxx Cluster system]]{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Voxx Cluster system]] |coordinates=[[Standard Galactic Grid|S-7]] |xyz= |distance= |suns= |orbited= |position= |moons= |routes= |lengthday= |lengthyear= |class= |diameter= |atmosphere= |climate= |gravity= |terrain= |water= |interest=*[[Racing starfighter|Starfighter]] [[Sky race|racing]] circuit{{Resistance|The Voxx Vortex 5000}} *[[Vranki's Hotel and Casino]] |flora= |fauna= |otherlife= |species= |otherspecies= |socialgroup= |language= |government= |population= |demonym= |cities= |imports= |exports= |affiliation= }} {{Quote|My old friend Vranki has a deluxe high-stakes racing circuit out in the Voxx Cluster.|Hype Fazon|audio=VoxxCluster-TheVoxxVortex5000.flac|}} The '''Voxx Cluster''' was an [[asteroid field]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Ash Worlds]]. It was located in a [[Color|purple]]-colored [[Nebula|nebulous]] region and was the site of [[Vranki's Hotel and Casino]]. The owner, [[Vranki]], also hosted a [[Racing starfighter|starfighter]] [[Sky race|racing]] circuit among the Voxx Cluster's [[asteroid]]s, where the [[pilot]] [[Hype Fazon]] once learned to [[Racer|race]]. In [[34 ABY]], the mobile [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|space station]] ''[[Colossus]]'' arrived at the Voxx Cluster, where Fazon hoped that he and the other pilots of the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station's]] [[Ace Squadron]] could earn the ''Colossus'' much-needed [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] by participating in high-stakes racing. However, Vranki [[Team Vranki|employed]] fast, armed [[droid racer]]s as well as other dishonest methods in order to always ensure a victory for himself. In a series of races held in the Voxx Cluster known as the [[Voxx Vortex 5000]], most of the Ace Squadron pilots lost against Vranki's [[droid]]s until [[Kazuda Xiono]] finally prevailed and thus helped secure [[Currency|credits]] for the ''Colossus''. ==Description== {{Quote|I still can't believe you learned to race in an asteroid field.|Kazuda Xiono, to Hype Fazon|audio=LearnToRace-TheVoxxVortex5000.flac|}} The Voxx Cluster was an [[asteroid field]]{{SW|url=the-voxx-vortex-5000-episode-gallery|text="The Voxx Vortex 5000" Episode Gallery}} {{C|slide 2}} situated in the [[Voxx Cluster system]] that was located in grid square S-7 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] as part of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and [[the Slice]]. It lay in the [[sector]] known as the [[Ash Worlds]]. The Voxx Cluster was located in a [[Color|purple]]-colored [[Nebula|nebulous]] region and consisted of a winding closed loop of [[asteroid]]s that also contained a higher concentration of the matter making up the surrounding nebulosity. ==History== ===A promising idea=== {{Quote|Hype Fazon. Ha ha ha! The greatest racer to come out of the Voxx Cluster.|Vranki|audio=GreatestRacer-TheVoxxVortex5000.flac|}} [[File:FazonPitchToDoza-TheVoxxVortex5000.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Hype Fazon (center) suggested to Captain Imanuel Doza (third from right) that the ''Colossus'' visit the Voxx Cluster.]] The criminal known as [[the Lobber]] once claimed to his [[Idiot Three|partners-in-crime]] [[Wungo]] and [[Ghor]] that the Voxx Cluster was a type of [[candy]].''[[The Living Force]]'' In [[33 BBY]],{{LivingForceDate}} Wungo, erupting into an outburst of annoyance at the Lobber's incompetence while on the [[planet]] [[Valboraan]], refuted the claim's validity. At some point, the [[Hutt]] [[Vranki]], who hailed from the Voxx Cluster, established there both [[Vranki's Hotel and Casino]] and a deluxe high-stakes [[Racing starfighter|starfighter]] [[Sky race|racing]] circuit. He was also the first racing sponsor of the [[pilot]] [[Hype Fazon]], who learned to race in the Voxx Cluster's asteroids and was considered by Vranki to be the best [[racer]] to emerge from the circuit. Fazon eventually moved on from racing for Vranki and became a pilot of the [[Ace Squadron]], based on the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|station]] ''[[Colossus]]''. In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|9}} the ''Colossus'' was facing a shortage of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for acquiring supplies while the [[First Order]] was [[Hunt for the Colossus|hunting]]{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-voxx-vortex-5000-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "The Voxx Vortex 5000" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} the mobile [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]]. During that [[time]], Fazon suggested to the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[captain]], [[Imanuel Doza]], that he allow the pilots of the Ace Squadron to participate in racing in the Voxx Cluster, which would both fulfill the pilots' desire to race and provide a means to potentially earn much-needed [[Currency|money]] for the ''Colossus''. ===Casinos and races=== {{Dialogue|TC-G3|This is a straight one-on-one race. First racer to pass through the final hoop wins.|Xiono|Hype's got this. Straight run doesn't sound so hard.|Yeager|Yeah. Except there's no such thing as a straight run in an asteroid field.|attr=TC-G3, Kazuda Xiono, and Jarek Yeager|audio=StraightRun-TheVoxxVortex5000.flac|src=}} [[File:GreenAceVsDroidRacer-TheVoxxVortex5000.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Hype Fazon's starfighter (foreground) competing against Vranki's droid racer (background)]] After Doza agreed with the proposal, the [[Space station|station]] traveled to the Voxx Cluster, where a [[Star Commuter 2000|shuttle]] took Doza, the [[Technician|mechanics]] [[Jarek Yeager]] and [[Neeku Vozo]], and the Ace Squadron pilots Fazon, [[Torra Doza]], [[Kazuda Xiono]], [[Freya Fenris]], [[Griff Halloran]], and [[Bo Keevil]] to Vranki's Hotel and Casino. There, Torra and Xiono witnessed through the [[casino]]'s [[viewport]] a trio of Vranki's racing starfighters—in reality, [[Droid racer|droid starships]]—competing in the asteroid race course, with one of the racing [[Starship|craft]] exploding upon colliding with an asteroid. Fazon, confident in his ability to prevail in any contest set on the Voxx Cluster circuit, then agreed to enter a race against one of [[Team Vranki|Vranki's racers]]—on the condition that he would enter servitude to the Hutt if he lost. The event was observed from the casino by Vranki; his announcer [[droid]], [[TC-G3]]; and Fazon's companions. During the race, the Ace Squadron pilot noted that his competitor, whom he believed was an organic being, was flying through the Voxx Cluster at a speed higher than what Fazon had previously witnessed from other racers in the circuit. ===Voxx Vortex 5000=== {{Quote|What? No fair! He went off course!''"
"''Well, you said it yourself, Vranki. Anything can happen.|Vranki and Hype Fazon, on Kazuda Xiono|audio=AnythingCanHappen-TheVoxxVortex5000.flac|}} [[File:VoxxVortex5000-TheVoxxVortex5000.png|thumb|left|300px|The Voxx Vortex 5000, featuring Kazuda Xiono's starfighter (right) and Vranki's droid racer (left)]] Fazon subsequently lost the race, during which the droid racers' true nature was revealed. Captain Doza then negotiated another deal with Vranki—the latter agreed to organize an impromptu race known as the [[Voxx Vortex 5000]], in which the other Ace Squadron pilots would compete against Vranki's droids to win back freedom for Fazon. Fenris also went on to lose the race, after which it was attempted by Keevil. In order to distract the pilot enough to cause him to lose as well, Vranki activated free-floating [[magnetic mine]]s that proceeded to detonate one of the Voxx Cluster's asteroids. Halloran entered the race next, only to suffer a loss as well due to Vranki employing [[cannon]]s placed on some of the asteroids. Finally, Torra and Xiono entered the Voxx Vortex 5000 in the form of a relay race against Vranki's droids. The droid competing against Torra slowed her down by opening fire with its on-board [[blaster]]s, blowing up several of the Voxx Cluster's asteroids in the process. In the subsequent leg of the race, Vranki once again used [[magnet]]ic [[mine]]s, cannon emplacements, and the droid racer's own [[weapon]]ry to hinder the progress of Xiono. Nevertheless, the pilot, who went off the course in order to travel straight toward the [[Sky ring|finish hoop]], ultimately won the Voxx Vortex 5000. Captain Doza and his [[Team Colossus|team]] subsequently departed from Vranki's Hotel and Casino with their newly won credits, after which the ''Colossus'' left the Voxx Cluster. ==Locations== {{Quote|Welcome, visitors, to Vranki's Hotel and Casino.|TC-G3|audio=VrankiHotel-TheVoxxVortex5000.flac|}} [[File:VrankisHotelAndCasino-TheVoxxVortex5000.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Voxx Cluster was home to Vranki's Hotel and Casino.]] The Voxx Cluster was the site of the Vranki's Hotel and Casino facility. Viewports in the casino offered a view of the nearby asteroid racing circuit, and the establishment's [[hologame]]s were modeled after it. The perilous nature of the race course made it attractive to new pilots, who sought excitement in beating low odds of success and could prove their mettle against the hazards of the asteroid field.{{Databank|voxx-cluster|Voxx Cluster}} The course was outfitted with several free-floating finish hoops—modified through the addition of a pair of cannons—as well as a pair of [[holoprojector]]s that together formed a [[Hologram|holographic]] countdown screen for the competitors. In addition, to help ensure his racers' victory, Vranki employed several cannon emplacements positioned on the race course's asteroids as well as a number of free-floating magnetic mines that, upon activation, would pursue a specific racing craft through the asteroid field. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:VoxxCluster-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jim Moore's concept art of the Voxx Cluster]] The Voxx Cluster was introduced in "[[The Voxx Vortex 5000]]," the ninth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. The episode was aired on [[December 1]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} Prior to the debut of "The Voxx Vortex 5000," the asteroid field was depicted in a trailer for ''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two released on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [https://www.youtube.com/c/StarWars YouTube channel] on [[August 14]] of the same year.{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance}} On [[November 27]], 2019, the Voxx Cluster was named in a preview of the episode released on the same channel.{{SWYouTube|A-nHEEJDdWs|"The Voxx Vortex 5000" Preview | Star Wars Resistance}} [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Jim Moore]] made a concept art illustration of the Voxx Cluster on [[April 6]], [[2018]],{{SW|url=the-voxx-vortex-5000-concept-art-gallery|text="The Voxx Vortex 5000" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 10}} while on [[March 24]] of the same year, [[Aaron Pham]] created a concept art [[:File:VrankisHotelAndCasinoeExterior-ConceptArt-AaronPham.png|illustration]] of the exterior of the asteroid field's Vranki's Hotel and Casino.{{ArtStation|subdomain=aaronpham|url=pages/lucasfilms|name=[[Aaron Pham]]|text=Star Wars Resistance / Clone Wars (Designed, Modeled and Colored by Aaron Pham)}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source="[[The Voxx Vortex 5000]]" |storyboards= |concept= File:VoxxCluster-ConceptArt.jpg|The Voxx Cluster, Jim Moore File:VrankisHotelAndCasinoeExterior-ConceptArt-AaronPham.png|Vranki's Hotel and Casino exterior, Aaron Pham File:VrankisHotelAndCasino-ConceptArt-PathOfResistance.png||Vranki's Hotel and Casino during the Voxx Vortex 5000{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|featurette=Path of Resistance}} File:VoxxCluster-ConceptArt-PathOfResistance.png|The ''Colossus'' at the Voxx Cluster |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Voxx Cluster}} *''[[The Living Force]]'' {{Ab|The Living Force (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *{{Resistance|The Voxx Vortex 5000}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 -
